chapter.verse: Ka haina neukha note in na thuak le-uh teh ka ut hi.

Na thuak taktak un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in note nungak siangtho bangin Khazih kiangah kong piak nadingin pasal khat tawh ka hong kiteengsak zo ahih ciangin, Pasian tawh kipawl lunghihmawhna tawh, note ading ka lunghimawh hi.
Gulpi in ama zuauna tawh Evua a kheem mah bangin note lungsim ngam-in kisia-in, Khazih lamah a om khin na lungsim siangtho uh a mangthang ding hi ci-in ka lunghihmawh hi.

No omna-ah a hong pai mi in ko hong hilh loh Zeisu khat hong hilh zongin, na ngah ngei loh uh Kha Siangtho na ngah uh zongin, na ngaih nai loh uh Lungdamna Thu na ngai uh zongin tua-pa na thuak thei uh hi.
Keimah in sawltak liante nuaiah neukha bek a neuzaw ka hi kei hi.
Ka kam hangin a pil lo mi ka hi zongin pilna lamsangah pil lo mi ka hi kei hi. Hih thu khempeuh note apawl pawlin kong lak zo uh hi.
Note pahtawi nadingin keima pumpi ka niamsak a, thaman la loin note kiangah Pasian’ Lungdamna Thu kong gen kong hilh ciangin ka mawh hiam?
Note nasem dingin adang pawlpite tung pan thaman dangka sang a, amau sum a sut ka suak ta hi.

No tawh ka omkhawm lai takin na khat peuhpeuh ka deih ciangin kuamah tungah vangik ka guan’ kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Makedonia gam pan a hong pai ute naute in ka deihna khempeuh hong pia hi. Note tungah gimna khat ka suah loh nadingin kei in na khempeuhah ka kikem hi. A nung ciangin zong ka kikem lai ding hi.
Khazih’ thuman thutak in keima sungah a om mah bangin Akhaia gamah hi bang ka kisaktheihna kuamah in hong khaam zo kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam? Note ka hong it loh hang ahi hiam? Kong it cih Pasian in a thei hi.
Thu nei nuamte in a neih theih loh nading ahi zongin, amau kisaktheihna-ah kote banga tel taka, kilat theih nading ahi zongin ka hih bangin ka hih lai ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua bang mite in sawltak zuau ahi uh hi. Khazih’ sawltak banga kibawl a kheem thei nasemte ahi uh hi.
Hih thu in lungmanhuai hi lo hi. Satan nangawn in khuavak tawh kipawl vantungmi bangin a kibawl thei hi.
Tua bang ahih ciangin ama nasemte zong thudikna’ nasem bangin a kibawl leh, bang genna a om ding hiam? Amau in amau gamtatna hangin a tawpna-ah a thuak ding uh hi.
Khatvei ka genin ah, keimah in mihai hi ci-in kuamah in hong um kei hen. Ahih kei leh, kei zong a neukha ka kisaktheih na’ngin, kei mihai bangin hong ngaihsunin hong thuak un.
Hih bang ka genna in Topa’ thupiak bangin gen ka hi kei hi, mihai bangin, lau loin, kisathei-in ka gen hi.
Mi tampite in ci-le-sa ah kisathei uh ahih ciangin keimah in zong ka kisathei ding hi.
No mipilte na hih uh ciangin ki-itna lungsim tawh mihaite na thuak uh hi.
Mi khat in note sila hong suaksak ahi zongin, hong ne ahi zongin, hong man ahi zongin, a kiphasak ahi zongin, na biang uh hong beeng ahi zongin na thuak uh hi.
Kote hatna nei lo hi ci-a hong kikosiatna paulamin kong ci hi. Ahih hangin na khat peuhpeuh ah mi khat lau loin a om leh, keimah in zong lau loin ka om hi ci-in mihai bangin ka gen hi.
Amaute in Hebru mi ahi uh hiam? Kei in zong ka hi hi. Amaute in Israel mi ahi uh hiam? Kei in zong ka hi hi. Amaute in Abraham’ suan ahi uh hiam? Kei in zong ka hi hi.

Amaute in Khazih’ nasemte ahi uh hiam? Kei in zong ka hizaw hi ci-in mihai bangin ka gen hi. Gim mahmaha nasem zaw mi, thong sungah khiatna a thuakzaw mi, satna tupna kisim zo lo a thuak mi, sihna ding tawh tam veipi kituak ka hi hi.
Nga vei dongin Judah mite’ khut sungah sawmli-ah khat a kiam satna ka thuak zo hi.

Thum vei dongin ciing pum tawh satna ahi zongin, khat vei suang tawh den’na ahi zongin ka thuak zo hi. Thum vei dong teembaw siatna ka thuak zo hi. Sun khat leh zan khat tawntung tuipi sungah ka om zo hi.

Tam veipi thuhilhin ka zin hi, gun galkah kihtakna, mi suamte kihtakna, ka mi pawlte’ hong bawlsiatna launa, Gentailte’ bawlsiatna launa, khuapi sungah a tung launa, gam lakah a tung launa, tuipi launa, u leh nau banga kibawl mite’ bawlsiatna launa, hih gimna khempeuh ka thuak zo hi.
Gim mahmah a, hahkatna tawh nasepna, tamveipi gilkialna dangtakna, tam veipi antan’na, khuadam thuakna, puan nei lo-a omna, hih gimna khempeuh ka thuak zo hi.
A pua lamah a om tua thute tham loin, pawlpi khempeuh lunghihmawhna tawh nisimin gimna ka thuak hi.
Ka tha kiam lohin kua tha kiam ahi hiam? Ka lunggim lohin kua in khial ahi hiam?
Kisathei ding ka hih leh, ka thanemna bek suangin ka kisathei ding hi.
Keimah in zuau thu ka gen kei hi cih a tawntung thupha a ngah Topa Zeisu’ Pa leh Pasian in a thei hi.
Damaskas khua-a Aretas kumpipa’ khua ukpa in kei hong man dingin Damaskas khua ah hong pan’ lai takin,
nungzuite in seeng sungah khuapi kulh tung panin hong khiasuk uh a, ama khut sungpan ka suakta hi.
